findings.title: canopy-monitoring has no in-function auth; anon JWT can list pulls and trigger Canopy refreshes
findings.description: verify_jwt=true accepts the published anon JWT. The handler never calls requireAuth/verifyAuth/CRON_SECRET. It uses SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY and supports list/refresh/check_due/refresh_all_due, dumping canopy_pulls (account/lead ids and monitoring state) and calling the Canopy Monitoring API.
findings.impact: Anyone with the public anon key can enumerate Connect pulls across the project and force carrier refreshes, enabling reconnaissance and third-party API abuse.
findings.attack_path:
1. Read VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY from the frontend bundle.
2. POST /functions/v1/canopy-monitoring with Authorization Bearer anon and {"action":"list"}.
3. Handler selects completed pulls via service_role with no auth gate.
4. Follow with refresh or refresh_all_due to hit Canopy.
findings.remediation: Require staff JWT plus is_canopy_staff()/workspace bind, or fail-closed CRON_SECRET. Reject the anon key. Scope list/refresh to the caller's workspace.
findings.poc_video_notes: PoC video not feasible: requires a live multi-tenant Supabase project and must not exploit production.

findings.title: canopy-servicing allows anon JWT to submit/list/confirm servicing actions without staff or workspace checks
findings.description: Auth runs only for email-delivery ID-card/declarations paths. submit for add/remove vehicle/driver, update coverages/address, list, status, confirm, and capabilities proceed with service_role and no caller identity. Gateway verify_jwt=true still accepts the public anon JWT.
findings.impact: Unauthenticated (anon-key) callers can queue carrier policy changes and dump servicing action history including account/lead linkage.
findings.attack_path:
1. Obtain published anon JWT.
2. POST /functions/v1/canopy-servicing with {"action":"list"}.
3. POST submit with pull_id and action_type add_vehicle without email fields.
4. Service-role inserts canopy_servicing_actions and calls Canopy; no staff check.
findings.remediation: Require authenticated staff plus workspace membership on the pull's account for every action. Do not treat anon JWT as authorization.
findings.poc_video_notes: PoC video not feasible: requires a live multi-tenant Supabase project and must not exploit production.

findings.title: execute-ai-module OCR/analyzes arbitrary document_ids via service_role with requireAuth-only
findings.description: After requireAuth (any JWT including portal), attacker-supplied document_ids are loaded with service_role. Missing extracted_text triggers Azure OCR; text is sent to Azure OpenAI; result is returned. No staff or workspace check.
findings.impact: Any authenticated user including a customer portal user can exfiltrate insurance document content via model output for any document UUID and burn Azure DI/OpenAI quota.
findings.attack_path:
1. Authenticate with any user JWT.
2. POST /functions/v1/execute-ai-module with module_slug and victim document_ids.
3. Service-role loads and OCRs the document.
4. Response result contains extracted victim content.
findings.remediation: Require is_staff() and is_agency_member on each document's account workspace before load/OCR. Prefer a user-scoped client so RLS applies.
findings.poc_video_notes: PoC video not feasible: requires a live multi-tenant Supabase project and must not exploit production.

findings.title: ai-document-analysis downloads attacker-chosen storage paths and document IDs with service_role
findings.description: Distinct from ai-document-analysis-simple. requireAuth only. Attacker-controlled documentPaths are downloaded from the documents bucket via service_role, OCR'd, and fed to the AI. context.metadata.documentId loads any documents row and downloads its storage object.
findings.impact: Cross-tenant document exfiltration and OCR/AI quota abuse by any authenticated principal who knows or guesses storage paths or document UUIDs.
findings.attack_path:
1. Authenticate with any JWT.
2. POST /functions/v1/ai-document-analysis with documentPaths of a victim storage object.
3. Or pass context.metadata.documentId for a victim UUID.
4. Service-role download + OCR; response includes extracted fields.
findings.remediation: Bind every path/id to a document row the caller can access via workspace membership. Ignore caller bucket/path; resolve storage only from authorized rows.
findings.poc_video_notes: PoC video not feasible: requires a live multi-tenant Supabase project and must not exploit production.

findings.title: renewal-rate-watch processes and emails any rate-watch workspace without membership checks
findings.description: Service-role client + requireAuth only. Attacker-supplied workspace_id loads workspaces and documents with no ownership check. Actions include process_documents, generate_report, generate_email, send_email, and full_pipeline.
findings.impact: Cross-tenant read of renewal quote bundles, overwrite of rate-watch artifacts, and outbound renewal emails on behalf of another agency.
findings.attack_path:
1. Authenticate with any JWT.
2. POST /functions/v1/renewal-rate-watch with action full_pipeline and victim workspace_id.
3. Service-role runs extraction/comparison/report/email draft.
4. Optional send_email queues or sends the draft.
findings.remediation: Require staff membership on the account/agency tied to the workspace. Gate send_email with client-send approval plus workspace bind.
findings.poc_video_notes: PoC video not feasible: requires a live multi-tenant Supabase project and must not exploit production.

findings.title: process-document-batch lets any authenticated user claim and OCR any batch_id
findings.description: requireAuth only. Attacker-chosen batchId selects queued document_processing_queue rows via service_role, downloads storage objects, runs OCR, inserts documents rows, and updates queue status.
findings.impact: Cross-tenant queue drain, OCR of foreign files, document row injection under victim account_id, and AI quota abuse.
findings.attack_path:
1. Authenticate with any JWT.
2. Learn or guess a batch_id.
3. POST /functions/v1/process-document-batch with that batchId.
4. Background worker downloads and OCRs those queue items via service_role.
findings.remediation: Fail-closed CRON_SECRET or staff plus membership on the batch workspace. Do not accept interactive JWTs for queue claim.
findings.poc_video_notes: PoC video not feasible: requires a live multi-tenant Supabase project and must not exploit production.

findings.title: ai-task-generator creates tasks on arbitrary account_id with service_role and requireAuth-only
findings.description: Any authenticated user supplies triggerData.account_id. Matching rules insert into tasks via service_role with that account_id and no is_agency_member or staff check.
findings.impact: Portal or foreign-tenant users can plant tasks on other agencies' accounts.
findings.attack_path:
1. Authenticate with any JWT.
2. POST /functions/v1/ai-task-generator with a valid triggerType and victim account_id.
3. Service-role inserts tasks under that account.
findings.remediation: Require staff plus is_agency_member on triggerData.account_id before insert.
findings.poc_video_notes: PoC video not feasible: requires a live multi-tenant Supabase project and must not exploit production.

findings.title: comparison-report reads any comparison workspace and publishes HTML via getPublicUrl
findings.description: Same requireAuth+service_role+workspace_id class as comparison-extract, with unique extra impact: generated HTML is uploaded to workspace-documents and exposed with getPublicUrl.
findings.impact: Cross-tenant disclosure of comparison snapshots/results plus a durable public URL for the report HTML.
findings.attack_path:
1. Authenticate with any JWT.
2. POST /functions/v1/comparison-report with victim workspace_id.
3. Service-role loads comparison_results and policy_snapshots.
4. HTML uploaded; record includes public html_url.
findings.remediation: Require workspace ownership/membership before read. Use signed URLs, not public URLs, for reports.
findings.poc_video_notes: PoC video not feasible: requires a live multi-tenant Supabase project and must not exploit production.
